newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banco de Mexico sold additional dollar put options.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Mexico sold additional dollar put options.

text.p: Banco de Mexico said it auctioned some $300 million in dollar put options on Friday, as part of its recently announced plan to build reserves by upping the amount of its dollar put options.
The central bank said in a statement the average premium on the options was 15.08 pesos.

Banco de Mexico had said on Wednesday that it would auction an additional $300 million in options each month when more than 80 percent of options sold to financial institutions on the last day of the previous month had been exercised.
Unlike the initial auction amount, which is valid for the coming month, the second set of options will only be valid for the second half of each month.
The dollar options are designed to allow the central bank to build reserves in times of peso strength.
